name: Youth Volunteers for Conservation (YV4C)
what_you_do: Youth help restore prairie and savanna. For example, they gather native seeds. They learn to name basic native plants. They also hear about jobs in natural resources.
who_can_apply: Young adults ages 15 to 21. If you are under 18, a parent must sign a separate form.
duration: Single sessions of about 2 hours (the one listed was Oct 10, 2026, 1 to 3 pm)
deadline_text: The only session listed was Saturday Oct 10, 2026, 1 to 3 pm at Pheasant Branch Conservancy, 5000 Pheasant Branch Rd, Middleton. No later dates are posted on the page; check MyImpact or ask for new sessions.
how_to_apply: Make a MyImpact volunteer account. If you are under 18, use a separate form. Fill out the waivers. They cover rides, a yearly background check and the YV4C behavior pledge. Then sign up for a shift. Contact Grace Coleman at (608) 228-2590.
notes: The event page lists only the Saturday, Oct 10, 2026 session (1 to 3 pm). Check MyImpact or call the coordinator at (608) 228-2590 for new session dates.
